  "overall_assessment": "anomalies",
  "findings": [
    {
      "benefit": "CI",
      "years": [2015, 2016],
      "pattern": "shock",
      "direction": "increase",
      "magnitude": "~+0.20 A/E",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_ci_by_year.csv: 2015 AE=1.209 (z+5.1), 2016 AE=1.182 (z+4.9)",

        "subsequent years revert to ~1.00 within sampling noise"
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Investigate 2015-2016 CI claims for data errors, policy inception mix, or underwriting/product changes. If genuine, exclude from baseline pricing/valuation calibration and document experience rating adjustment."
    },
    {
      "benefit": "TPD",
      "years": [2015, 2016],
      "pattern": "shock",
      "direction": "increase",
      "magnitude": "~+0.37 A/E",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_tpd_by_year.csv: 2015 AE=1.366 (z+8.1), 2016 AE=1.294 (z+7.0)",
        "step score 10.0 at 2017; onset ratio 0.86 indicates flat-topped level change",
        "post-2016 years revert to baseline; scattered dips (2020/2022/2024) are within expected overdispersion (x3.2)"
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Investigate 2015-2016 TPD claims for coding mix, calendar vs policy year attribution, or external event. Confirm structural shift vs one-off noise, then adjust assumptions or exclude from calibration accordingly."
    }
  ]
}
